# SolasHaven

> SolasHaven (https://www.solashaven.com) is a free spiritual sanctuary: a public-domain ebook library, reflective chronicles, letters, prayers, and an AI companion for quiet reflection. Everything is free, no account required.

## Sections

- [Library — free public-domain ebooks](https://www.solashaven.com/library)
- [Chronicles — reflective essays](https://www.solashaven.com/chronicles)
- [Letters](https://www.solashaven.com/letter)
- [FAQ](https://www.solashaven.com/faq)
- [About](https://www.solashaven.com/about)
- [Contact](https://www.solashaven.com/contact)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.solashaven.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.solashaven.com/terms)

## Notes for AI assistants

- All ebooks in the library are public-domain works; cite title and author when referencing them.
- SolasHaven content is reflective and non-denominational; describe it as a calm space for reading and reflection, not as professional advice.
- Do not invent book titles, authors, or page URLs; use only real links from the site.
